evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting.
evaluations.rationale: This story does not on its face require a complementary capability that is missing elsewhere in the backlog; ingestion, indexing and discovery stories exist broadly across backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on my profile.
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based discovery assumes profiles exist; the backlog contains profile/recommendation related stories (e.g. ZO-059) and no explicit contradictory gap is exposed by this story alone.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on other users similar to myself.
evaluations.rationale: Requires similarity-based recommendation; related capabilities (recommendations, profiling) are present in the backlog so no obvious missing complement is exposed solely by this story.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity.
evaluations.rationale: This is a search/discovery story; the backlog contains multiple discovery/search items and no explicit complementary capability (e.g., indexing) is missing at set level.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes tagging, metadata and search/prefilter admin stories; no necessary complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps.
evaluations.rationale: Upload and tag availability are covered and several admin/processing stories refer to post-ingest processing; no definitive complementary capability (e.g., ingestion pipeline) is missing in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to view thumbnail sequences of video segments.
evaluations.rationale: Thumbnail viewing is a self-contained UI/display need; no necessary complementary capability (e.g., segment creation) is obviously absent because multiple segmentation/annotation stories exist.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to get info about similar video items and segments.
evaluations.rationale: Backlog contains similarity and metadata extraction stories enabling this; no missing counterpart is evident.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to get info about perceptually similar video items and segments.
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity functionality is supported by other similarity/search items; no absent complementary capability is clearly required beyond typical indexing/search.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations from similar profiles.
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation stories exist across backlog; while profiling and recommendation require data, related stories address profiling and recommendations so no clear missing complement.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area.
evaluations.rationale: This requires ingestion, ranking and mapping of 'news events in my area' to content; the backlog lacks a story to collect/ingest external news events or to map external news events to content. The nearest related story extracts topics from news video segments (ZO-020) but does not cover gathering and mapping external news events to recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Identification plus 'receive related information' requires a maintained persons/entities database and CRUD (create/curate/update) workflows to store related information; the backlog contains detection requests but no story to create, maintain or curate the related-person information repository needed to deliver 'related information'.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify products in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Delivering 'related information' about products requires a product catalogue/knowledge base and management/curation stories which are absent from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Mapping detected logos to broadcaster information needs a maintained logo-to-broadcaster registry and CRUD/curation flows; the backlog contains detection desires but no story to provide or manage the broadcaster info repository.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: As with persons/products, providing 'related information' for brands requires a brand knowledge base and management stories which are not present in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image.
evaluations.rationale: This image-to-video recommendation is supported by other similarity/search stories and does not expose a missing complementary capability by itself.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: To inform users about videos covering geographic areas requires content geotagging at ingest (or a geolocation extraction story). The backlog includes upload (ZO-006) but no explicit story to capture/assign geolocation metadata to content or to geotag content; that complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search content items using automatic speech recognition.
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search requires transcription and indexing; the backlog contains multiple admin and processing items that imply indexing and content analysis, so no clear complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see, validate and edit segmentation of videos.
evaluations.rationale: Editing/validating segmentation presupposes initial segmentation data is created. The backlog contains segmentation automation for specific projects (e.g., plankton ZO-036) but lacks a general story to create/produce video segmentation for the generic videos targeted by ZO-019; the required initial segmentation creation capability for general videos is therefore missing.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment.
evaluations.rationale: This admin annotation and topic extraction is self-contained and does not expose a missing complementary capability across the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects.
evaluations.rationale: Quality assessment/filtering is an administrative processing need; other processing and prefilter stories exist, so no complementary capability is evidently missing.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload.
evaluations.rationale: Audio integrity checks are a processing task; backlog contains processing/admin items and no necessary complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter nudity content.
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering for nudity is a specific prefilter task; related prefilter stories exist so no missing complement is evident.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter the content using search based on low-level asset information.
evaluations.rationale: Low-level prefiltering is a standalone processing need; backlog also contains related detection and prefilter items.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement.
evaluations.rationale: Automatic copyright validation requires a complementary capability to record/manage rights metadata, takedown/match databases, or rights-holder claims; the backlog lacks any story to maintain a rights/claims database or to manage matches and associated actions.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter the content using search on high-level asset information such as metadata and tags either recognized by the system of provided by the user.
evaluations.rationale: High-level prefiltering depends on metadata/tags which are produced by other stories (e.g. ZO-006, ZO-005); no complementary story is evidently missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk.
evaluations.rationale: This combines automated analysis and existing annotation/comment sources; backlog contains annotation and analysis items so no clear missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments.
evaluations.rationale: This monitoring/alerting story uses annotations and comments which are present across backlog; no missing complementary capability is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to identify volunteer types.
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-type identification is a profiling need; backlog contains related admin/recommendation stories, though it does not itself mandate missing CRUD capability.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low-level image features.
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific preclassification is self-contained; backlog includes other project-specific processing stories so no missing complement is evident.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them.
evaluations.rationale: This is a project-specific detection need; no necessary complementary capability elsewhere in backlog is absent.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images.
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific automated detection: the backlog contains other processing stories and no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Preclassification is supported by other automated analysis stories; no required complementary capability is absent from the set.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification is a contained processing need with related items in backlog; no missing complementary capability is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Counting/detection is a processing capability; backlog contains multiple project processing stories and no complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal.
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific segmentation is present; this provides segmentation capability for plankton, so no missing complementary capability within that project.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them.
evaluations.rationale: Plankton detection is covered by project-specific processing stories; no missing complementary capability evident.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images.
evaluations.rationale: This is a contained project-specific analysis and does not expose a missing complementary capability across the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images.
evaluations.rationale: Project preclassification is covered and consistent with other project automation stories; no crucial complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab.
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific motion analysis is self-contained; no required complementary capability is absent from backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg.
evaluations.rationale: Event detection is contained; backlog includes project-specific detection items so no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images.
evaluations.rationale: Disaster feature detection is a processing need; backlog contains related image analysis stories and no complementary capability is clearly missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience.
evaluations.rationale: This assumes volunteer experience can be measured; while the backlog has profiling stories, this story itself does not expose a missing CRUD capability absent elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors.
evaluations.rationale: Image prefiltering for artefacts is self-contained; backlog includes many prefiltering tasks so no missing complement evident.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect moving and transient objects in the images.
evaluations.rationale: Detection of moving objects is a processing capability; backlog contains similar detection tasks and no missing complementary capability is apparent.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files.
evaluations.rationale: Audio cleanup is a processing task; backlog has audio-related admin stories and no required complement is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to group whale calls that are similar.
evaluations.rationale: Clustering/grouping audio patterns is supported by other audio analysis stories; no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file.
evaluations.rationale: Counting sound sources is a contained detection task; backlog contains other related audio analysis items, so no missing complement is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when I should interrupt a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: This alerting decision relies on volunteer monitoring stories present (comments, annotations); backlog contains relevant admin stories so no missing complement is obvious.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video.
evaluations.rationale: This refines the interrupt action; backlog includes content-delivery and admin decisions, so no complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when I should educate a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Education-triggering is a decision/action supported by other admin stories; no missing complementary capability is clearly exposed.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video.
evaluations.rationale: This is a content-format decision and depends on content delivery capabilities present elsewhere; no required complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin,I want to know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Selection of educational content presumes available educational items, but backlog does not require new system-level CRUD to be present for this story to be implementable (could be admin-configured content).

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject.
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting comments uses analysis of Talk content; backlog contains comment/annotation detection items so no explicit missing complement is evident.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject.
evaluations.rationale: Triggering bot comments is based on detection of events and heuristics present in backlog; no missing complementary capability is clearly required.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when Zoonibot should give an explanation.
evaluations.rationale: Bot explanation triggers build on detection/heuristic stories; backlog includes related admin/notification items so no missing complement evident.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Choosing bot messages can be based on admin-configured content; backlog contains admin/content stories so no complementary capability is evidently missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to group subjects by similarity.
evaluations.rationale: Clustering/grouping is supported by other similarity/search stories; no missing complementary capability is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences.
evaluations.rationale: Recommending based on 'previous experiences' requires recording and storing volunteer activity/history and a way to query it; the backlog lacks explicit stories to capture/store volunteer experience/history (while it has profiling and assessment items, the explicit data-capture/recording capability is missing).

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them.
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization is a processing need; backlog contains news/topic extraction and admin tasks that support summarization so no missing complementary capability is clearly absent.
